title: Aery Early Birds Bundle
description: The "Aery Early Birds Bundle" features the first 3 titles of the Aery Series. Experience the original roots of the Aery Seires, lean back and enjoy the feeling of flying. All 3 games are story-driven non-violent exploration games where a little bird has to collect shards of its memory in order to discover new worlds and continue with the storyline. The games included are: - Aery – Little Bird Adventure - Aery – Sky Castle - Aery – Broken Memories
